company.name: Boulevard
company.shortDescription: Boulevard provides beauty and wellness businesses with tools for booking, payments, marketing, and client relationship management.
company.description: Boulevard provides a client experience platform designed for appointment-based, self-care businesses such as salons, medspas, and barbershops. Its features include precision scheduling for optimizing calendars and client self-booking, an all-in-one point-of-sale system, and built-in marketing and loyalty programs. The platform aims to streamline operations and enhance client retention for beauty and wellness brands.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based business management platform for appointment-based beauty and wellness businesses, combining booking, client management, payments, marketing, memberships, reporting, and operational tools.

productsAndServices.description: Client relationship management tools for maintaining profiles, appointment history, communications, documentation, and other information used to personalize service and manage relationships.

productsAndServices.description: Customer engagement tools for email and text marketing, automated campaigns, two-way messaging, loyalty programs, memberships, and packages.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series D round raised $80,000,000, or 42.55% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $8,097,660 to $800,000,000, a 98.79x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
